sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: \+ succeeds when its goal cannot be proven, rather than when an explicit opposite fact is known.
sketches.resonance: The language lets absence of proof become a kind of truth.

sketches.mechanism: A finally block executes even when the try block returns, intervening before control can leave.
sketches.resonance: Departure is not allowed to happen without one last unavoidable act.

sketches.mechanism: The preprocessor removes #if 0 regions before parsing or compilation, so their contents never enter the program.
sketches.resonance: What is enclosed there exists in the source but is denied a life in the world that runs.
